post.description: Completes a login that /login flagged as requiring 2FA.

Generates a new TOTP secret for the current admin. 2FA stays disabled
until /2fa/enable confirms the authenticator was configured correctly.

Requires the current password, not just a valid session, so a
hijacked access token alone can't strip 2FA off the account. Also
revokes every other session, the same as a password change.

Always responds the same way whether or not the email matches an
account, so this endpoint can't be used to enumerate registered users.

get.description: The branch / academic year this token is pinned to (null = not pinned).

post.description:
Texts a parent a login code. Same empty response whether or not the
number matches an account, so it can't be used to enumerate parents. The
SMS goes out after the response so response time doesn't give it away
either. Limited per phone (not per IP) so rotating IPs can't bomb a parent.
